about: How many values each walkthrough plan shows as known after apply, and why each one can't be known at plan.
make plan-quality fails when a count rises, a path appears or a reason is missing, and when a count falls, so this stays the measurement.
make unknown-budget-update rewrites the counts and paths and keeps the reasons. TESTING.md has the rest.
